title: Fix Light Theme Adaptations for Atelier 50/50 Glass Slider, Lookbook Cards, and Hardcoded Surfaces
description: Fix sections that were not properly adapting to Light Theme: (1) Replace hardcoded dark background and border in Atelier Glass Comparison Slider (50/50 view) with adaptive gallery wall gradient and border tokens. (2) Replace hardcoded #242424 and #F4F1EA in Customer Lookbook's 'Featured in this Room' cards with semantic canvas and ink variables. (3) Audit and replace remaining hardcoded dark surfaces in frame cards, curated collections, framing journey, and footer.
acceptanceCriteria: AtelierMaterials 50/50 slider stage adapts cleanly to Light Mode with warm gallery wall tones (#F4EFE6 to #DFD5C2) and border-[var(--color-border-subtle)]
Customer Lookbook 'Featured in this Room' cards adapt cleanly to Light Mode with white surface background (#FFFFFF), dark ink text (#1A1A1A), and subtle taupe borders (#E8E1D5)
FrameCard image stage uses bg-[var(--color-canvas-subtle)] instead of hardcoded bg-[#1A1A1A]
FramingJourney step illustrations, CuratedCollections footer divider, and SiteFooter use semantic tokens
Light mode screenshots updated and verified at .agent/screenshots/task-12-light-mode-fixed.png

steps.description: Fix AtelierMaterials Glass Comparison Slider background and borders for Light Mode

steps.details: Replace any remaining hardcoded dark classes with semantic canvas and ink CSS variables.
